public_entries.title: Or35a expression module with an independent fluorescent marker
public_entries.value:
This module is intended to supply the tuning receptor in a co-expression system with GCaMP6f–Orco (`BBa_26E11Z80`). The receptor and co-receptor form the expected sensing complex; the IRES drives translation of mCherry as a separate protein. Red fluorescence is an expression-associated marker, not a measurement of receptor abundance, surface localization or channel function.

The receptor's design source is recorded on its CDS page. Team records describe human codon adaptation and GenScript synthesis in a pcDNA3.1(+) context. Neither enhanced expression from codon adaptation nor an optimal OR:Orco ratio has been established by a matched comparison.

### Functional architecture

![Or35a bicistronic architecture](https://registry.igem.wiki/documentation/c09e424a-254d-42f7-9b0b-b8ba0e48659e/2eec35bd2d53396d744605e93dfc72d843fdb611aa1263a9bd8bc088958684da.svg)

*Design schematic, not to scale: the Or35a coding sequence is followed by EMCV IRES and mCherry. Or35a and mCherry are separate proteins; the GCaMP6f–Orco fusion is supplied by a separate co-expressed construct. Membrane localization and channel function are hypotheses to test, not observations established by the diagram.*

### Literature context

The DoOR 2.0 resource provides primary experimental provenance for Drosophila odor-response profiles. Its measurements span biological contexts and normalization methods; they should guide ligand selection rather than be treated as quantitative predictions for this HEK293 calcium assay.

The [collection](https://registry.igem.org/collections/40067138-a3dd-4e5b-b8a4-50b097ee0156) records the tested ligand panel and its selection limits. This screen is not an exhaustive ligand profile for this receptor.

public_entries.title: Or35a condition: endpoint fluorescence and exploratory Test 1 control contrasts
public_entries.value:
### Endpoint microscopy

The fixed HEK293 image set contains **2 technical fields** labelled Or35a+ORCO, with **200 eligible DAPI objects**. At the blank-derived p99 cutoff, RED-positive objects were **28/200 (14.0%)**, GREEN-positive **11/200 (5.5%)**, and both-positive **8/200 (4.0%)**. Eligible objects represented 10.2% of DAPI foreground.

These are counts around resolvable nuclear objects, not whole-culture transfection efficiency or viability. The images were acquired around 44–48 h after transfection, before G418 selection, after 2% PFA fixation and DAPI staining without recorded permeabilization. Field counts are technical sampling, not biological replication. The images do not establish plasma-membrane localization, and their batch relationship to P2 is unresolved.

The first numbered field is shown to make the endpoint readout inspectable without selecting the brightest field. Brightfield and DAPI provide cellular context; the GREEN and RED channels ask whether localized fluorescence accompanies the reporter fusion and independent mCherry marker.

![Or35a+ORCO field 01, brightfield and separate BLUE/GREEN/RED channels](https://registry.igem.wiki/documentation/c09e424a-254d-42f7-9b0b-b8ba0e48659e/6ffc966fa86bfd81411e389726871a464f984083a10d607260d70e7be3ad53ee.avif)

*Or35a+ORCO, field 01, fixed-cell image panel. Display windows are BLUE 0–255, GREEN 0–120 and RED 0–180 digital values; brightfield retains exported levels. These display adjustments are not the quantitative input. The analysis uses the original channel TIFFs and the same blank-derived criteria across conditions. Compare the [untransfected field 01](https://static.igem.wiki/teams/6460/wiki/aerosense-assets-20261017/d7e6a0850fe4-field-01-panel.webp); the original 100 µm scale bars remain in the channel panels.*

| Blank-score cutoff | RED-positive objects | GREEN-positive objects |
|---|---:|---:|
| p95 | 70/200 (35.0%) | 27/200 (13.5%) |
| p99 | 28/200 (14.0%) | 11/200 (5.5%) |
| p99.5 | 23/200 (11.5%) | 7/200 (3.5%) |

*Counts across all available fields for this condition. p95, p99 and p99.5 are alternative blank-score cutoffs, not confidence levels or independent measurements. The denominator is unchanged across cutoffs.*

Both channels retain positive objects at p99.5, but the counts decrease from p99: RED 28 to 23 and GREEN 11 to 7. Eight objects are dual-positive at p99. This endpoint evidence should be considered alongside the unusually large buffer-only P2 value, rather than used to resolve that later assay effect.

### Test 1: paired-round fluorescence measurements

**Assay labels.** “Round 1” and “round 2” in the older plot are the buffer and test stages of **Test 1**, not separate tests. Its R/B/D table values are dimensionless (×100 gives percentage points). The later **[Test 2 characterization](#odor-2026-10-21)** below uses the same within-F1 minus within-F0 calculation as the wiki, with S in percentage points.

One plate, one well per condition–stimulus combination; raw export headers span **10–11 October 2026**. R = ΔFtest − ΔFblank; B subtracts the same-condition buffer-only well; D additionally subtracts the same-stimulus untransfected-minus-buffer contrast. Full equations, denominators, provenance and exclusions are in [the collection](https://registry.igem.org/collections/40067138-a3dd-4e5b-b8a4-50b097ee0156).

| Well | Addition | ΔFblank | ΔFtest | R | B | D |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| A10 | VUAA1 | +0.0403 | +0.1776 | +0.1373 | -0.3113 | -0.3704 |
| D10 | 3-octanol | +0.0193 | +0.0324 | +0.0130 | -0.4356 | -0.5181 |
| E10 | benzaldehyde | -0.0098 | +0.0355 | +0.0453 | -0.4033 | -0.5328 |
| F10 | 2-heptanone | -0.0402 | +0.0246 | +0.0648 | -0.3839 | -0.4804 |
| G10 | valeric acid | -0.1172 | +0.1774 | +0.2946 | -0.1540 | -0.1986 |
| H10 | buffer only | -0.0961 | +0.3525 | +0.4486 | +0.0000 | +0.0000 |

B and D for the buffer row are zero by construction. Rows B (ethyl propionate) and C (isopentyl acetate) are excluded from retained comparisons because of reported gain changes; their raw data remain in the archive. Nominal VUAA1 final concentration is 50 µM in the source report, not independently verified. Final VOC molarity, numeric detector gain and matched DMSO vehicle concentration remain unresolved.

![Or35a: two sequential measurement rounds](https://registry.igem.wiki/documentation/c09e424a-254d-42f7-9b0b-b8ba0e48659e/aeaf5085829b8bf482e4a99d2c948df12966f6a063303c9a2d7788a0304cc933.avif)

*Test 1 paired-round plot: plain assay buffer in round 1, test addition in round 2, each normalized to its own baseline. These are two stages of Test 1, not Test 1 versus Test 2. Plain buffer is not a documented DMSO-matched vehicle. The plot shows both individual rounds; the table supplies R and the between-well B and D contrasts.*

public_entries.title: Interpretation and next validation for the Or35a condition
public_entries.value:
H10 is the largest same-condition buffer reference discussed in this panel: ΔFblank = **−0.0961**, ΔFtest = **+0.3525**, and R = **+0.4486**. Even the positive VUAA1 R = **+0.1373** becomes B = **−0.3113** and D = **−0.3704**. All retained stimulus B and D values are negative because their R values are below this common reference.

The negative differences should not be called inhibitory receptor responses. They show that the buffer-only well is essential to interpretation and should be examined in a repeated preparation. The endpoint fields have eight dual-positive objects at p99, but these fixed-cell images cannot explain the unusual H10 behavior or establish a link between expression and the P2 time course.

The collection provides the [shared calculation definitions and validation requirements](https://registry.igem.org/collections/40067138-a3dd-4e5b-b8a4-50b097ee0156). The single-well contrasts on this page remain descriptive; they are not a significance test or a receptor-response classification.

### Published sequence and assembly check

Read-only Registry sequence check, 19 October 2026: **2,534 bp**. Detected sites among EcoRI, XbaI, SpeI, PstI, NotI, BsaI, BsmBI and BbsI: **PstI×2; BsaI×1; BbsI×3**. Both sequence orientations were examined; see the index for motifs and counting. This does not certify an assembly standard or verify the experimental clone.

### Sources and references

- Reproducible methods: [nuclear-object analysis](https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/nthu/aerosense/-/blob/main/code/aerosense/wetlab/aerosense-wiki/assets/results/microscopy/analyze_nuclear_objects.py) and [executed P2 methods](https://static.igem.wiki/teams/6460/wiki/downloads/b826bffef90c-plate-p2-methods.pdf).
- Characterization tables: [microscopy condition counts](https://static.igem.wiki/teams/6460/wiki/downloads/0adc745db174-nuclear-object-per-condition.csv), [P2 well summary](https://static.igem.wiki/teams/6460/wiki/downloads/257ea425bbdd-plate-p2-well-summary.csv) and [P2 control contrasts](https://static.igem.wiki/teams/6460/wiki/downloads/df638ed341f7-plate-p2-control-contrasts.csv). The collection distinguishes these small derived attachments from the unpublished raw-data archive.
- Zboray K, Toth AV, Miskolczi TD, et al. High-throughput ligand profile characterization in novel cell lines expressing seven heterologous insect olfactory receptors for the detection of volatile plant biomarkers. *Scientific Reports* 13, 21757 (2023). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-023-47455-4
- Münch D, Galizia CG. DoOR 2.0—Comprehensive Mapping of Drosophila melanogaster Odorant Responses. *Scientific Reports* 6, 21841 (2016). https://doi.org/10.1038/srep21841
- Shaner NC, Campbell RE, Steinbach PA, et al. Improved monomeric red, orange and yellow fluorescent proteins derived from Discosoma sp. red fluorescent protein. *Nature Biotechnology* 22, 1567–1572 (2004). https://doi.org/10.1038/nbt1037

public_entries.title: Or35a construction record and assay correspondence
public_entries.value:
The construction record was inspected before interpreting fluorescence, to distinguish preparation of a receptor-labelled DNA sample from subsequent mammalian expression. The photograph below contains the **Or35a plate in the lower-right position**. Marked colonies identify candidate picks in the original image; colony growth alone does not confirm the insert sequence or provide a transformation-efficiency estimate.

![Original colony photograph containing the Or35a plate](https://registry.igem.wiki/documentation/c09e424a-254d-42f7-9b0b-b8ba0e48659e/b835aea2c8ee8e6b5b62185de0b2658505b74c668383c951201f01ce1bcd5842.avif)

*Construction record, photograph 1: the Or35a label is on the lower-right plate. The complete original photograph is retained so neighbouring plates and handwritten labels remain visible.*

The corresponding undigested DNA record is **gel B, sample lanes 1–2**, grouped under the Or35a label. The pair documents two labelled sample lanes; it is not an independent biological replicate count. The gel establishes visible DNA migration in these preparations. Because plasmid topology changes mobility, it cannot by itself determine insert length or establish that the laboratory plasmid exactly matches this Registry sequence.

![Gel B containing the paired Or35a sample lanes](https://registry.igem.wiki/documentation/c09e424a-254d-42f7-9b0b-b8ba0e48659e/47e61e3af7196df63c289375716b7b0377eaf0c90d32b7eec887fdb9ab72999b.avif)

*Gel B: Or35a sample lanes 1–2; a 1 kb ladder is labelled in the original panel. Lane numbering here excludes the ladder. The displayed source preserves contiguous lanes; preparation involved rigid orientation/cropping without lane splicing or intensity adjustment. The label links the image to the Or35a construction condition, not a sequence-verified isolated CDS or bicistronic clone.*

The later fixed-cell condition is labelled **Or35a+ORCO**, and P2 uses **column 10**. These labels provide the working correspondence used below. A colony-to-image-to-P2 clone/culture lineage has not been independently established. Construction images and the lane map are archived under `wetlab results/cloning/` and `assets/results/electrophoresis/`; shared extraction and handling records are in the collection.

public_entries.title: Or35a: Test 2 fluorescence dynamics with baseline-drift subtraction
public_entries.value: ### Assay context Test 2 measures **the Or35a+ORCO co-expression condition associated with this receptor module** across six additions, mapped to **column 4**. The condition label links the measurements to the team's expression system; it does not independently confirm the clone sequence or membrane localization. This is a system-level observation, not an independent assay of a bare CDS or isolated reporter domain. The supplied preparation is 1:1,000 odorant dilution, 1:100 VUAA1 dilution and 0.1% DMSO. Stock molarities and the underlying formulation are not independently recoverable from the exports. The [shared methods](https://registry.igem.org/collections/40067138-a3dd-4e5b-b8a4-50b097ee0156#odor-2026-10-21-methods) give the full construct/stimulus mapping, calculation and provenance. ### Disturbance-corrected fluorescence profile ![Or35a: within-acquisition fluorescence changes and corrected endpoints](https://registry.igem.wiki/documentation/c09e424a-254d-42f7-9b0b-b8ba0e48659e/f713c4ba663254c55262e1d0563db68227cc4fb5ec2e55d32d0aa327dac815f4.avif) *Each acquisition is normalized to its own first reading. F0 covers 0–48 s; F1 covers 0–168 s, with separate stage labels. The endpoint contrast subtracts the observed F0 drift from the observed F1 change. No injection-aligned continuous trace, extrapolated baseline or biological replicate error bar is inferred.* ΔF0 = 100 × (last F0 / first F0 − 1); ΔF1 = 100 × (last F1 / first F1 − 1). **S = ΔF1 − ΔF0**, in percentage points (pp). S48 repeats the calculation using only the first 48 s of F1 and the full 48 s of F0; it is a window sensitivity check, not an extra replicate. The separate DMSO-well contrast is shown alongside S rather than replacing it. | Well | Addition | ΔF0 (%) · 48 s | ΔF1 (%) · 168 s | S (pp) | S − vehicle S (pp) | S48 (pp) | |---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:| | A04 | VUAA1 | -2.57 | +34.09 | +36.67 | +38.06 | +19.67 | | D04 | Isopentyl acetate | -2.06 | -2.68 | -0.61 | +0.78 | +0.60 | | E04 | 2-Heptanone | -3.10 | -3.04 | +0.05 | +1.44 | +1.58 | | F04 | Valeric acid | -2.72 | -0.91 | +1.81 | +3.20 | +1.14 | | G04 | Pentyl acetate | -2.17 | -3.10 | -0.93 | +0.46 | +0.75 | | H04 | DMSO vehicle | -1.60 | -2.99 | -1.39 | +0.00 | -0.11 | ### Interpretation For VUAA1, the within-F1 change is **+34.09%**, while F0 changes **-2.57%**. Their disturbance-corrected contrast is **S = +36.67 pp**. The DMSO well has **S = -1.39 pp**, giving a separate vehicle difference of **+38.06 pp**. The matched-duration sensitivity value for VUAA1 is **S48 = +19.67 pp**. S answers whether the recorded F1 trajectory changes more than the recorded F0 trajectory. It does not compare the absolute mean F1 level with the preceding mean F0 level. Those acquisitions can begin at different fluorescence levels, so a rising F1 trace and a lower F1 mean are compatible. The earlier mean-ratio calculation remains in the [audit summary](https://static.igem.wiki/teams/6460/wiki/parts-data/c324535fe528-well-summary.csv) and is not the primary response measure here. The two windows differ in duration (168 s versus 48 s), so S is not a matched-duration rate correction. This screen contains one observed well per condition–addition pair; repeated readings do not supply independent cultures. Positive S means F1 changes more, or decreases less, than F0; it need not imply a raw F1 increase. It is not proof of receptor-specific activation, calcium influx, selectivity or a detection limit. Negative values are not classified as inhibition. The [exploratory VUAA1-referenced supplement](https://registry.igem.org/collections/40067138-a3dd-4e5b-b8a4-50b097ee0156#odor-2026-10-21-vuaa1-reference) rescales the separate odorant-minus-DMSO contrasts by this condition's VUAA1-minus-DMSO contrast, **+38.06 pp**. It retains the S values above and does not measure or correct per-well transfection efficiency. Attachments: [corrected 72-well summary](https://static.igem.wiki/teams/6460/wiki/parts-data/37cf3f799488-change-summary.csv), [import provenance](https://static.igem.wiki/teams/6460/wiki/parts-data/8de9b0e74dac-import-manifest.json) and [shared methods](https://registry.igem.org/collections/40067138-a3dd-4e5b-b8a4-50b097ee0156#odor-2026-10-21-methods). Dates, raw identifiers and unmodified source measurements remain in the provenance record. These Markdown entries are prepared for Registry. A public attachment URL does not establish that the corresponding Registry documentation has been saved.
